title: PaymentRefunded
description: Everything a card payment had taken was given back to the shipper's card. The carrier's part came out of their card income, the platform's out of its revenue.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payment_id.description: The card payment of the load.

load_id.description: The load the payment is for.

load_code.description: The load's short code, for example `GW-7F3K2M`; null when billing was not told it.

authorized.description: What stands blocked on the card for the load, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

carrier_org_id.description: The carrier organization of the haul.

amount.description: What went back to the card, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).

commission.description: The platform's part of it, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today): the haul's commission is no longer charged.
